name: tancode
description: A lightweight, local-first coding companion that helps developers learn technical concepts while vibe coding and understand errors without relying on their coding agent for every explanation.

tancode.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server. Tancode never calls external AI services.

tancode.ollama.model.description: Ollama model used for explanations. Must already be pulled — see `ollama list`.

tancode.maxSourceBytes.description: Files larger than this many bytes are not sent to the model.

tancode.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for each Ollama request in milliseconds. Non-streamed generation must finish within this budget; local models on CPU often need 60s+.

tancode.fallbackToRuleBased.description: Show the deterministic rule-based explanation (clearly labelled, not AI-generated) when the model is unavailable.

tancode.proactive.enabled.description: Let Tancode proactively explain errors and code insights. Pause/resume also available in the panel.

tancode.proactive.level.description: How chatty proactive assistance is: 'all' explains errors and code insights; 'errors-only' only explains editor errors and warnings.

tancode.proactive.cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between proactive assistant messages.

tancode.proactive.maxPerSession.description: Maximum unsolicited proactive messages per panel session.

tancode.proactive.frequency.description: How often Tancode may speak first. custom uses tancode.proactive.cooldownSeconds.

tancode.explanation.depth.description: Default depth of explanations and the output budget per answer.

tancode.explanation.simplified.description: Include plain-language explanations and real-world analogies alongside technical detail.

tancode.explanation.interactiveQuestions.description: Allow Tancode to ask occasional knowledge-check questions.
